cases: an empty list: UsageError: cases in evaluate("e") is an empty list. Give at least one case.

cases: caseKey returns a number: UsageError: caseKey in evaluate("e") must return a string (got 1 for cases[0])

cases: a key that is too long: UsageError: cases[0] in evaluate("e") has the key "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx": a case key is 1–80 characters, with no #, /, › or control characters. Pass caseKey to give it another.
cases: an empty key: UsageError: cases[0] in evaluate("e") has the key " ": a case key is 1–80 characters, with no #, /, › or control characters.

cases: with best-of runs: UsageError: evaluate("e") has cases, so it can't take runs: { bestOf }: best-of stops each cell on its own, and the cases pool over the runs. Set a fixed count, e.g. runs: 3.
where: without cases: UsageError: evaluate("e") sets where without cases. where picks case-and-environment pairs; to drop an environment, leave it out of environments.
where: not a function: UsageError: where in evaluate("e") must be a function from a case and an environment to true or false, e.g. where: ({ case: item, environment }) => item.stacks.includes(environment.traits.stack).
where: in a group: UsageError: Unknown option "where" in group("g"). where is an option of evaluate() and survey() only, beside cases: evaluate(name, { cases: [...], where: ({ case, environment }) => … }, …).
where: reads a trait no environment defi: UsageError: evaluate("e")'s where reads environment.traits.stak, which no environment defines (they define: stack). Did you mean "stack"?
where: returns a string: UsageError: evaluate("e")'s where returned "yes" for case q001 on next-app; it must return true or false.
where: throws: UsageError: evaluate("e")'s where threw for case q001 on next-app: no such stack

where: excludes every pair: UsageError: evaluate("e")'s where excludes all 4 case-and-environment pairs, so it has nothing to run.
